infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace trains between Central and Bondi Junction. Trains do not stop at Wolli Creek
infoLinks.content:
Wednesday 29 and Thursday 30 October
  • Nightly from 9.50pm to 1.30am, buses replace trains between Central and Bondi Junction.
  • Trackwork buses do not leave from Martin Place Station, use metro services.
  • Most trains run to a changed timetable between Waterfall or Cronulla and the City Circle, with some making extra stops at St Peters and Erskineville.
  • Change at:
    - Sydenham or Central for metro services to Martin Place
    - Central for buses to Kings Cross and Edgecliff
    - Town Hall for express buses to Bondi Junction

  • Nightly from 10.10pm to 1.30am, trains do not stop at Wolli Creek but make an extra stop at Arncliffe.
  • Buses run between Sydenham, Wolli Creek and Arncliffe.
  • Change at Arncliffe or Sydenham for a bus to Wolli Creek or change at Central for a T8 Airport train if you have luggage or accessibility needs.

  • Replacement buses for trackwork may be affected by driver shortages. We are doing all we can to minimise the impact to your journey and provide a safe service, however cancellations or delays may occur.
  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes
20T4 Bondi Junction, Edgecliff, Kings Cross, Central and return (bypassing Martin Place)
23T4 Bondi Junction, Town Hall and return
36T4 Arncliffe, Wolli Creek, Sydenham and return
324/325 City, Walsh Bay to Watsons Bay via Town Hall (Park St), Kings Cross, Edgecliff stations and return
333 City to Bondi Beach via Martin Place and Bondi Junction stations and return

infoLinks.content:

  • Plan your trip and check timetables before you travel.

urlText: Station Update - Central
content:
From Monday 16 June 2025, Eddy Avenue Plaza in front of the entrance into Central Station will be closed for construction works.
For access from Eddy Avenue into Central Station, use the covered walkway by going through the sandstone archway located to the right of the pedestrian traffic crossing. 
Follow the signs for the footpath detour.
Please allow for additional travel time to get to the station entrance.

infoLinks.urlText: T1 North Shore Line: Buses replace trains between Hornsby and Milsons Point. Use metro between Chatswood and the City
infoLinks.content:
Monday 27 and Tuesday 28 October
  • Nightly from 9.15pm to 1.30am, buses replace trains from Hornsby to Milsons Point.
  • The last train from Hornsby to the City leaves Hornsby at 21:12, arriving Wynyard at 21:55.

  • Nightly from 9.50pm to 1.30am, buses replace trains from Milsons Point to Hornsby.
  • The last train to Hornsby leaves Wynyard at 21:52, arriving Hornsby at 22:35.
  • Replacement buses also stop at Crows Nest and Victoria Cross metro stations.
  • Use metro services between Chatswood, Crows Nest or Victoria Cross and the City.
  • T9 trains run between Berowra or Hornsby and Central, platforms 1-14.
  • Some late-night buses run between T1 North Shore Line stations and Wynyard.

  • Replacement buses for trackwork may be affected by driver shortages. We are doing all we can to minimise the impact to your journey and provide a safe service, however cancellations or delays may occur.
  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.

infoLinks.urlText: Bus diversions for MS Gong ride
infoLinks.content:

infoLinks.urlText: L4 Westmead and Carlingford Line partial closure during Parramatta Lanes
infoLinks.content:
From Wednesday 22 to Saturday 25 October, due to road closures and for pedestrian safety during Parramatta Lanes, L4 Westmead and Carlingford Line light rail services will not run between Westmead and Parramatta Square during the following times: 
  • From 5pm to 11pm on Wednesday 22 and Thursday 23 October  
  • From 5pm to 11.30pm on Friday 24 and Saturday 25 October  
Light rail services will continue to run between Parramatta Square and Carlingford. 

During this time, use alternative transport including trains, regular bus services, L4 replacement bus services or walking if able to, between Westmead and Parramatta Square. 

L4 replacement bus services: 

Replacement bus services will run every 10 to 15 minutes from 5pm to 11pm on Wednesday 22 and Thursday 23 October, and from 5pm to 11.30pm on Friday 24 and Saturday 25 October. These times may vary depending on road traffic. 

Replacement buses will not stop at the following locations: 
  • Westmead Hospital – please use the alternative stop at Westmead Station (approx. 6 minutes walk) 
  • Ngara – please use the alternative stop at Benaud Oval (approx. 5 minutes walk) 
Most replacement buses will be accessible; if not, wait for the next service. 

Allow extra travel time and use the Trip Planner or check travel alerts to see if your travel is affected. 

Check signs at stops and see the event page for more info.

infoLinks.urlText: L1 Dulwich Hill Line partial closure due to maintenance
infoLinks.content:
From Saturday 1 to Friday 7 November, L1 Dulwich Hill Line light rail services will not run between Central and Convention due to planned trackwork and maintenance works.
 
During this time:
  • L1 light rail services will continue to run between Convention and Dulwich Hill.
  • Due to road closures, L1 replacement buses will only stop at Central Grand Concourse, Exhibition Centre (towards Central), Convention, and The Star.
  • Use alternative transport including regular bus services, L1 replacement bus services, or walking if able to, between Central Grand Concourse and Convention.
  • There will be no replacement buses at the following stops: Capitol Square, Paddy’s Markets, Exhibition Centre (towards The Star), and Pyrmont Bay.
L1 light rail services will resume as normal from 5am on Saturday 8 November.
 
See the news story for more detailed service information.
 
Allow extra travel time and use the Trip Planner or check travel alerts to see if your travel is affected.

infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace trains between Lithgow and Mount Victoria, or between Bathurst and Penrith
infoLinks.content:
Saturday 8 and Sunday 9 November
  • Buses replace trains between Lithgow and Mount Victoria.
  • Trains run between Mount Victoria and Central, some to a changed timetable.

  • Daily from 5.20am to 10pm, buses replace trains between Lithgow and Penrith.
  • Buses also replace some Bathurst trains.
  • The 20:24 Central to Lithgow will be the first train to run towards Lithgow.
  • The 21:18 Mount Victoria to Central will be the first train to run towards the City.

  • If you are travelling to Lithgow to connect with NSW TrainLink Regional Coaches, please call 132 232 to confirm departure times.

  • Replacement buses for trackwork may be affected by driver shortages. We are doing all we can to minimise the impact to your journey and provide a safe service, however cancellations or delays may occur.

infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace trains between Central and Bondi Junction. Some trains do not stop at Wolli Creek
infoLinks.content:
Wednesday 29 and Thursday 30 October
  • Nightly from 9.50pm to 1.30am, buses replace trains between Central and Bondi Junction.
  • Trackwork buses do not leave from Martin Place Station.
  • Trains run to a changed timetable between South Coast Line stations and Central, platforms 1-14.
  • Change at Central for buses to Kings Cross, Edgecliff and Bondi Junction or metro services to Martin Place.

  • From 10.10pm to 1.30am, trains do not stop at Wolli Creek but make extra stops at Arncliffe and Sydenham.
  • Buses run between Sydenham, Wolli Creek and Arncliffe.
  • Change at Arncliffe or Sydenham for a bus to Wolli Creek, or change at Central for a T8 Airport train if you have luggage or accessibility needs.

  • Replacement buses for trackwork may be affected by driver shortages. We are doing all we can to minimise the impact to your journey and provide a safe service, however cancellations or delays may occur.
  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.

infoLinks.content:

Buses towards The Domain will end trips at QVB, York St, Stand D (Stop ID: 200044).
Buses leaving the city will start trips from QVB, York St, Stand B (Stop ID: 200042).
 
Customers can continue on foot or change for train services.

  • Art Gallery Rd opp Art Gallery of NSW, Sydney (stop ID 2000144)
  • Andrew (Boy) Charlton Pool, Mrs Macquaries Rd, Sydney (Stop ID 200097)

infoLinks.content:

  • Daily from 4am to 9am, Inner West trains run between Rhodes and the City, to a changed timetable and stopping pattern.
  • Trains from the City do not stop at Macdonaldtown, Newtown, Petersham or Lewisham. Trains to the City continue to stop at all stations from Ashfield to Central.
  • Buses run from Central to Ashfield, stopping at all stations, in that direction only.
  • Some T1 trains make an extra stop at Homebush.

  • Replacement buses for trackwork may be affected by driver shortages. We are doing all we can to minimise the impact to your journey and provide a safe service, however cancellations or delays may occur.

infoLinks.urlText: L2 and L3 light rail services may be temporarily held at stops or partially closed due to Police Operation
infoLinks.content:
• On Sunday 26 October, L2 Randwick Line and L3 Kingsford Line light rail services may be impacted between 2pm to 3pm approximately due to road closures around Town Hall for a planned Police Operation protest march:
    • L2 and L3 services may be temporarily held at stops, or 
    • L2 and L3 services may be temporarily partially closed between Circular Quay and Town Hall. 

  • Impact to services and timings may change at the direction of NSW Police.
  • Please check information screens at stops, listen to announcements and follow the direction of staff or Police on site, as necessary.
  • Allow extra travel time and use the Trip Planner for alternative transport options, including trains, buses or walking. 
  • L1 Dulwich Hill Line light rail services should continue to run as per normal.

infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace trains between Cronulla and Sutherland, and some trains between Waterfall and Hurstville
infoLinks.content:
Monday 3 to Thursday 6 November
  • Nightly from 9.40pm to 2.30am, buses replace trains between Cronulla and Sutherland.
  • Trains run to a changed timetable between Waterfall, Sutherland and Bondi Junction.
  • Monday and Tuesday, some trains make extra stops at St Peters and Erskineville.

  • Thursday from 11.55pm to 2.30am, buses also replace trains between Waterfall, Sutherland and Hurstville.

  • Replacement buses for trackwork may be affected by driver shortages. We are doing all we can to minimise the impact to your journey and provide a safe service, however cancellations or delays may occur.

infoLinks.urlText: Darling Point Ferry Wharf temporary closure for maintenance
infoLinks.content:
Monday 3 to Wednesday 5 November 2025
 
Darling Point Ferry Wharf will be temporarily closed for essential maintenance works including replacement of perished pile and rotten bracing on wharf boarding stairs.
 
For alternative transport, the 328 bus is available from Thornton St at Darling Point Rd which goes to Edgecliff and Bondi Junction.
 
Plan your trip for real-time up to date information.
